messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page triggered (PD-67219) — model-catalog-service detected a config mismatch for model 'redwood-chatx-7' in prod (us-west-2). Auto-page routed to rotation: eng-platform.

Maria S: I just got paged. This landed in eng-platform but it looks like a model-catalog -> oncall thing. Does anyone on the current oncall see this? @Sanjay K

Sanjay K: Acked PD-67219 :white_check_mark: I saw the alert. A quick summary: routing table points to rev=8 but the tokenizer on disk is the legacy bpe; mixed tokenizer/revision cause tokenization errors. I'm jumping in to confirm impact.

Maria S: Noted. Any customer-facing errors?

Sanjay K: Quick check against the hosted API edge: I ran a sampling of recent 5m logs, ~4% of requests to /v1/generate for model redwood-chatx-7 are returning 400 tokenizer errors. Affected region primarily us-west-2.

Sanjay K: Running quick metadata queries:
```bash
# get catalog entry
kubectl -n redwood-prod get cm model-catalog-redwood-chatx -o yaml
```
Output snippet:
```
data:
  revision: "8"
  tokenizer: "byte-bpe-v1"
  default_quantize: "int8"
  pinned: "false"
```

Sanjay K: Expected config for production should be revision 7, tokenizer "sentencepiece-v2", default_quantize "fp16". Looks like a promo pushed 8 with incorrect defaults.

Maria S: That matches the PD alert — looks like autopromote pipeline used wrong defaults. Is there a safe mitigation?

Sanjay K: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) pin the routing to revision 7 for prod us-west-2 2) roll back the catalog mapping from 8 -> 7 3) if rollback cannot complete quickly, apply model-level tokenizer-compat fallback routing to legacy-tokenizer for rev 8.

Ellie (on-call): I'm taking this one for live mitigation and customer comms. Handoff: Ellie here, will execute the rollback and monitor for 30m, escalate to SRE if errors spike.

Ellie (on-call): Performing rollback now — updating routing override via internal API.
```bash
# apply routing override (10m) to pin to rev 7
curl -s -X POST https://internal-routing.redwood/api/v1/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chatx","region":"us-west-2","target_revision":"7","ttl_seconds":600}' | jq .
```
Response:
```json
{"status":"ok","applied":true,"override_id":"ovr-2026-03-15-001"}
```

Ellie (on-call): Applying catalog rollback: creating new catalog mapping that pins production to rev 7 and sets tokenizer to sentencepiece-v2 and default_quantize to fp16.
```bash
kubectl -n redwood-prod patch cm model-catalog-redwood-chatx --patch '{"data":{"revision":"7","tokenizer":"sentencepiece-v2","default_quantize":"fp16"}}'
```
kubectl -n redwood-prod rollout restart deploy/model-catalog-service
```

Maria S: Thanks. Will monitor error rates and downstream K/V cache invalidations. I'm also opening a quick IM for customer impact triage.

Sanjay K: Verified initial metrics after override: tokenizer errors dropped from 4% -> 0.6% within 45s of the routing override. Some spike in tail latency (~80ms) from fallback routing, but acceptable.

Maria S: Customer list check: two higher-traffic customers saw increased 400s during the 6m window (acme-corp, medsys). I'll draft a brief note for account and trust to review.

Ellie (on-call): Leaving the override in place until we confirm the catalog roll-forward is clean. I'll hold for 30m then either remove override or extend. Also started a postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/ops/pm/PD-67219

PagerDuty: PD-67219 acknowledged by Sanjay K.

Maria S: Short-term remediation done. Next steps: 1) engineering postmortem, 2) fix autopromote defaults (CI gate), 3) add a canary check comparing tokenizer and revision before promotion.

Sanjay K: Agree. I'll file a follow-up issue against the autopromote pipeline and tag infra/ci.

Ellie (on-call): Handoff to Maria in 20 minutes for continued monitoring. If any customer escalations come in, @Sanjay K to assist.

Maria S: thanks — will take monitoring after 20m and prepare a 1-paragraph status update for customers.

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty PD-67219 — resolved (routing override and catalog rollback applied). Closed at 2026-03-15T12:17:05Z.

Ellie (on-call): Leaving final notes in the incident doc and will kick off the postmortem triage meeting tomorrow. :memo:
